# Hellhounds
## Hellhound usage etiquette Hellhounds may be used during preserve hunts, planetside hunts (sparingly), lodge defenses and abomination hunts.
In normal hunts, hellhounds must be used to break up or distract larger groups, and never sent to dispatch a single target unless it is dishonorable.
Examples of bad hellhound usage: - Taking a hellhound planetside and having it attack a lone target from the darkness. - Calling a group of 8 humans to the preserve and releasing many hounds at them.
Examples of good hellhound usage: - Calling a group of 8 humans to the preserve and sending one hound to break them up and distract them. - Using a hellhound planetside to distract a larger group of xenos helping your main prey.
## Hellhound expectations Listen to your master. When in doubt about whether to do something, ask.
## Hound master death When the hound's master dies, the hound must either be taken by someone else or killed, or sent to its certain death.
